name: Spacecraft (Transit)
description: Crew transit vehicle traveling between celestial bodies. High radiation exposure, strong isolation due to distance from Earth, full microgravity, and entirely closed life-support system.

name: Space Station (ISS)
description: The International Space Station in low Earth orbit. Baseline environment for space health monitoring with well-established countermeasure protocols and regular resupply missions.

name: Lunar Base
description: Surface habitat on the Moon. Higher radiation than LEO due to lack of magnetosphere, moderate isolation with 1.3-second communication delay, partial gravity (1/6 g), and semi-closed environment with potential for local resource utilization.

name: Mars Base
description: Surface habitat on Mars. Highest radiation risk due to thin atmosphere and no magnetosphere, extreme isolation with 4-24 minute communication delays, partial gravity (0.38 g), and closed environment dependent on in-situ resource utilization.
